Data-level PROC MEANS, PROC TABULATE, PROC FREQ and PROC TRANSPOSE

Source: R/data_api.R
sas_data_procs.Rd

Run one procedure on a data frame without writing a SAS program. sas_means_df(), sas_tabulate_df() and sas_freq_df() return the ODS table of the step (a sasonr_ods_table, a tibble with the SAS table attributes), or a list of them when there are several (one per BY group or table request); sas_freq_df() supports one-way (OneWayFreqs) and two-way (CrossTabFreqs) tables without statistics options so far; sas_transpose_df() returns the output data set. The arguments are read by the same parser and specification builder as the PROC step of a program, and the computation is the one sas_run() calls for that step, so the values and the column attributes are the same. sas_log() gives the WARNINGs and NOTEs of the computation and sas_html() the HTML document of the tables (both are S3 generics with methods for these results).

Usage

sas_means_df(
  data,
  var = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  stats = NULL,
  options = ""
)

sas_tabulate_df(data, table, class = NULL, var = NULL, by = NULL, options = "")

sas_freq_df(data, tables, by = NULL, weight = NULL, options = "")

sas_transpose_df(data, var = NULL, by = NULL, id = NULL, options = "")

Arguments

data

A data frame.

var, class, by, id

Variable names (character vectors).

stats

Statistic keywords of the PROC MEANS statement ("n", "mean", "std", ...); NULL gives the default statistics.

options

Further options of the PROC statement, as SAS text.

table

The TABLE statement of PROC TABULATE, as SAS text ("grp all, x*(n mean)").

tables

The TABLES statement of PROC FREQ, as SAS text ("grp sex", "grp / nocum").

weight

The WEIGHT variable (one name).

Value

See Description.

Examples

d <- data.frame(grp = c("a", "a", "b"), x = c(1, 2, 4))
sas_means_df(d, var = "x", class = "grp", stats = c("n", "mean"))
#> <sasonr_ods_table> Summary (Summary statistics)
#>   path:     Means.Summary
#>   proc:     Means, template base.summary
#>   columns:
#>     grp [class]
#>     NObs [stat] "N Obs"
#>     x_N [stat] "N"
#>     x_Mean [stat] "Mean"
#>   header 1: Analysis Variable : x 
#>   header 2: grp | N Obs | N | Mean
#>   rows:     2
as.data.frame(sas_tabulate_df(d, "grp all, x*(n sum)", class = "grp", var = "x"))
#>    grp _C1_ _C2_
#> 1    a    2    3
#> 2    b    1    4
#> 3 <NA>    3    7
as.data.frame(sas_freq_df(d, "grp"))
#>   grp Frequency  Percent CumFrequency CumPercent
#> 1   a         2 66.66667            2   66.66667
#> 2   b         1 33.33333            3  100.00000
sas_transpose_df(d, var = "x")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   `_name_`  col1  col2  col3
#>   <chr>    <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 x            1     2     4
